Type:      task

─── Description ───
  Shadow branch sync is push-only: after each commit, shadowPushAsync fires a detached git push. But there is no pull — other clones sharing the same remote kspec-meta branch never receive updates until manual kspec shadow sync. This causes: (1) divergence between clones (tasks created in clone A are invisible to clone B), (2) frequent merge conflicts when both clones push, (3) manual intervention required to reconcile. Type: feature
Implementation: in_progress
Description:

  eligible git target — the current repo's remote name, a different remote name,

    When: kspec init is run

    Given: kspec.config.yaml sets shadow.directory to a custom path

    When: kspec init is run
    Then: the worktree is created at the configured directory and .gitignore is updated accordingly
  [ac-3]
    Given: shadow.remote is set to a named remote (e.g. specs-origin)

    When: remote tracking is configured
    Then: push/pull operations use the named remote instead of origin
  [ac-4]

    When: remote tracking is configured
    Then: a git remote is added using the local path as target

    Given: shadow.remote is set to a git URL (contains :// or starts with git@)

    When: remote tracking is configured
